incidents.detail: Artifact writes and telemetry/gate writes are not atomic. A complete 552-line security_review.md was written at 03:44 but its telemetry event was never emitted and its gates entry never updated, so state.json recorded Gate 3 as 'not reached' and every downstream reader concluded it had not happened.

incidents.value_of_rerun: Non-trivial. Both passes agreed on the verdict but DISAGREED on D1, and the fresh pass additionally surfaced SEC-03, PRE-01 (High, pre-existing) and CFG-02.
incidents.recurrence: The same non-atomicity swallowed manifest.json at generate_final_report — see manifest_note. Twice in one run.

incidents.detail: Both reviewer subagents reported Glob/Grep missing from their tool surface and fell back to Bash for all enumeration, citing each command inline. Checks that could not run — notably `npm audit --omit=dev`, which fails ENOLOCK in this bun repo — are reported as unverified, never as passes.

The write contract lists `.sdlc/**` under off_limits with strict:true, and write-contract-check.mjs has NO carve-out for `.sdlc/runs/<run-id>/` despite the orchestrator contract stating that path is auto-allowlisted. Had the hook actually been registered, it would have denied every write to this run's own bookkeeping — state.json, telemetry.jsonl, final_report.md, this manifest.
incidents.status: latent — masked this run only because PROC-01 meant the hook never fired
incidents.structural_point: PROC-01 and PROC-05 currently cancel each other out. Fixing the hook registration WITHOUT adding the .sdlc/runs/<run-id>/ carve-out would deadlock the pipeline on its own record-keeping.

followups_open.summary: Make the busy/conference invariant type-enforced rather than emergent. Senior and security reviewers reached OPPOSITE recommendations; escalated to the human rather than silently resolved. A .refine() would not satisfy this — z.infer of a refined object is unchanged, so the TypeScript type stays exactly as emergent. A real fix restructures GridEventSchema into a discriminated union whose busy arm has no conference. Blast radius: 96 non-test files reference GridEvent, but only 9 non-test sites read .conference. No leak exists today.

getFocusedGridEventTarget (event.targeting.ts:51) shares resolveFromTarget, so it now returns null while the join button holds focus, silently no-opping ~10 keyboard-shortcut call sites while useIsAnyCalendarEventFocused.ts:22 still reports focused. A real side effect introduced by the B-1 fix; a proper fix needs event.targeting.ts, outside the allowlist.

Timed endDate resize handle overlaps the bottom ~2.25px of the 12px join button. R-1's browser probe was INCONCLUSIVE (the click missed the hit target entirely), so the overlap is still neither confirmed nor refuted. Non-blocking, unchanged from the Gate 3 decision. A human pressing the glyph's bottom edge by hand remains the only way to settle it.

z.url() empirically accepts javascript:, data: and vbscript:, and three sinks open conference.url unguarded: EventDetailsSection.tsx:48, UpNextCard.tsx:89, UpNextBanner.tsx:32 (React 18.3.1 is warn-only for javascript: hrefs). This delta is NOT the cause and already contains the correct fix pattern to copy — isSafeConferenceUrl. Highest-severity item the run surfaced.
